label: D-I029-1

branch.text: W1.5 mutant: pre-1d61908 — the streak walk reads shadow and today/future (preview) pick files

contract.text: Reconciliation recomputes the local streak from resolved past pick files only: a shadow pick file or a today/future (preview) pick file is not played, never enters the streak walk, and cannot end or abandon it.
contract.entry_mode: _replay_season_streak, called directly (test_streak_replay) and through reconcile_results with a fixed 02:00 ET clock (test_picks)
contract.trigger: a {date}.shadow.json beside a resolved hit (result None), or a future-dated preview pick file with result None
contract.symptom_kind: wrong value (the replay returns None, history unreconstructible, instead of the (streak, saver) of the resolved picks; reconcile then keeps the stale streak.json)

level_justification: only the MLB lookups on the reconcile path are replaced (get_game_statuses_detailed, check_hit); the direct replay test replaces nothing; pick files are prewritten in tmp_path and the reconcile clock is a fixed fixture value
